## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and the problem it solves.

## Verification

- [ ] The behavior change and its tests are in the same focused commit.
- [ ] Formatting, file-size, lint, typecheck, coverage, and build gates pass.
- [ ] No provider credential or generated document fixture was committed.
- [ ] Environment, API, security, or deployment changes are documented.
- [ ] Native-only changes were checked on the affected platform.

## Evidence

List the relevant tests, fixtures, screenshots, or manual checks. Explain any
intentional limitation or follow-up issue.
